title: Willpower Mastery, Unlocks, and Construct Upgrades
description:
Purpose: Track Willpower Mastery points, spend them at Construct Hall kiosks to unlock categories and upgrades that tune the construct system costs/durations/stability.

Behaviour:
- Earn: On mission completion or training challenges, receive mastery_points (int). Persist.
- Spend: In construct_hall scene, approach kiosks; press A (Right) to open unlock UI (via hud_wrist_menu). Purchase unlocks within categories (Attack/Defense/Control/Traversal/Utility/Heavy) and upgrades (e.g., stronger shields, longer tethers, reduced costs). Alcove statues light up on unlock.
- Effects: Publishes a CConstructTuning table that the promoted.ring_construct_core reads:
  - cost_multipliers per category
  - sustained_drain_multipliers
  - stability_bonus (reduces wobble, increases HP of constructs if simulated)
- Difficulty scaling: Track player power and feed enemy_ai_systems to adjust encounter composition (basic, advanced spawns).

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("interact_button", "A_right")

Components read/write:
- Writes CMasteryProfile{ points:int, unlocks:bitset/map } under CSavedProfile.
- Writes CConstructTuning published as a singleton, applied on scene load.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_save_persistence: Unlocks persist across sessions.

Assets/scenes: construct_hall, command_hall (debrief).
